events.label: founding
events.text: Kåfjord municipality established when Lyngen Municipality was divided into three.

evidence.quote: The municipality of Kåfjord was established in 1929 when the large Lyngen Municipality was divided into three

events.label: destruction
events.text: Villages of Kåfjord burned to the ground during German retreat.

evidence.quote: In 1945 , the villages of Kåfjord were burned to the ground

events.label: coat_of_arms
events.text: Municipal coat of arms dates from 1988.

evidence.quote: The coat of arms is from 1988

events.text: Nordnes area of Lyngen Municipality transferred to Kåfjord.

evidence.quote: Then on 1 January 1992 , the Nordnes area along the Lyngen fjord in Lyngen Municipality

events.text: Municipality name changed from Kåfjord to Gáivuotna–Kåfjord.

evidence.quote: The name of the municipality was Kåfjord until 2 May 1994 , when it was changed to Gáivuotna–Kåfjord

events.text: Name changed so either the Sami or the Norwegian name may be used.

evidence.quote: In 2005 , the name was again changed such that either the Sami Gáivuotna or the Norwegian Kåfjord name can be used

events.text: Svein O. Leiros begins term as mayor of Kåfjord.
Name changed again; Kven language name added to official names.

evidence.quote: In 2016 the name was changed again

events.text: Svein O. Leiros term as mayor of Kåfjord ends.
Bernt Eirik Isaksen Lyngstad begins term as mayor of Kåfjord.
Municipality became part of the newly formed Troms og Finnmark county.

evidence.quote: On 1 January 2020 , the municipality became part of the newly formed Troms og Finnmark county

undated_mentions: Northern Sami language largely lost in the 20th century
